metadata.title: Mods & texture packs — Nebula
metadata.description: What works in v2, how to import it and what to check if something breaks.

page.paragraph_2: What works in v2, how to import it and what to check if something breaks.
page.paragraph_3: These instructions cover the upcoming update. The current public download is v1.0.2.

supported.paragraph_1: v2 supports Riivolution mods, disc file replacements, Dolphin-format texture packs, HD movie replacements and changes to Nebula’s menu text. Use mods made for the supported region of Super Mario Galaxy.
supported.paragraph_2: Some Wii mods patch the Wii’s machine code. Those changes cannot run directly in a native game. Nebula reports unsupported code changes; a mod that needs them may not work. Texture pack support is not part of v1.0.1.

import.heading_1: Add a mod or texture pack.
import.paragraph_1: Use the launcher’s Mods tab or the in-game Mods page.
import.paragraph_2: Import a zip, 7z, rar or folder, or drop it onto the game window. Extract password-protected archives first.
import.paragraph_3: Move the mod into the enabled list. When two enabled mods change the same file or texture, the higher one takes priority.
import.paragraph_4: Choose any Riivolution options the mod provides, then Apply. Restart when prompted.

packs.paragraph_1: Dolphin-format texture packs use tex1_ PNG or DDS files. In Graphics → Texture packs, On loads replacements as needed; Preload loads them at startup and uses more memory.
packs.paragraph_2: HD movies can replace the game’s videos with MP4, WebM or MKV files supplied by a compatible pack. 4K video needs hardware decoding. If a video stutters, use a lower-resolution version or turn off that replacement.

mod-help.paragraph_1: Disable mods and try the same part of the game again. If the problem stops, enable them one at a time. Check the region, mod version and priority order. Error codes NEB-M01 and NEB-M02 can identify the mod or file involved.
